name: cli-bridge-mcp

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Health check: which CLIs are installed, which is the host, paid lanes, defaults, current cost profile. Pass deep=true to also probe each lane with a tiny live call (checks auth/quota — uses a bit of free quota; skips paid lanes).

tools.name: setup
tools.description: Show the cost-profile choice (saver/balanced/max) to walk the user through configuring how cli-bridge spends paid credits/quota. Call this on first use if the profile isn't set, ASK the user, then tell them how to set it.

instructions:
cli-bridge exposes the other AI CLIs installed on this machine as tools. Each lane spawns the official CLI as a subprocess (no API keys), read-only by default.

Tools: `ask_<lane>` one model · `ask_all` several in parallel · `ask_best` mode=fast|cheap|deep|code|review|security (the router picks) · `ask_cascade` cheapest→strongest with fallback · `ask_build` runs a build agent in a throwaway git worktree and returns a diff (mode=direct with async=true gives a steerable build: `job` action=status|result|tail|steer|cancel) · `review_diff` (focus=code|security) · `debate` (vote=judge|borda) · `workflow` presets (refine_plan, map_review, research_verify, fanout_compare, converge, premortem, test_plan, challenge) · `git_text` (kind=commit|pr) · `conversations` (no id = list, id = transcript) · `list_models` · `doctor`.

Threads: every `ask_<lane>` returns a thread id; reuse it on any lane to continue the same thread across a context reset.
Routing: after judging a delegate's answer, call `rate_lane(lane, mode, score 1-5, note)`; `ask_best` then prefers the lanes that scored well for that mode on this machine and shows the recent notes.
Cost: the profile saver|balanced|max (CLI_BRIDGE_PROFILE) and the caps CLI_BRIDGE_<LANE>_DAILY_LIMIT and CLI_BRIDGE_DAILY_CREDIT_CAP (needs CREDITS_PER_1K rates) are enforced at spawn. Tiers are sourced defaults (docs/COSTS.md), never read from the user's account; when the user says what a lane costs them, record it with `set_lane_cost(lane, cost, note)`. On first use with no profile or cost set, call `setup` once and don't assume 'free is best'.
Delegate hard or ambiguous problems, second opinions before risky changes, and domains a model is strong at. Not trivial edits or lookups.
